guidance.summary: Warriors open 24-0 and finish 73-9, breaking the 1995-96 Bulls' record

Kobe Bryant's farewell season, ending with 60 points in his finale

Mavericks lose to Oklahoma City 4-1 in Round 1

Blazers beat the injured Clippers 4-2, then lose to Golden State 4-1
Clippers lose Paul and Griffin and fall to Portland 4-2 in Round 1
Cavaliers beat the 73-win Warriors 4-3 after trailing 3-1; LeBron James is Finals MVP
Stephen Curry, MVP (unanimous)
Kawhi Leonard, Defensive Player of the Year (second straight)
Karl-Anthony Towns, Rookie of the Year (unanimous)
CJ McCollum, Most Improved Player
Jamal Crawford, Sixth Man of the Year (record third)
Hawks: step back from 60 wins, Millsap's third All-Star nod, Teague trade talk, late defensive surge
Nets: 0-7 start, Hollins fired and King reassigned, Sean Marks hired, Joe Johnson buyout, Lopez and Young shut down
Celtics: Isaiah Thomas All-Star, near-upset of 24-0 Warriors in double OT, win in Oakland, 48 wins
Hornets: Jeremy Lin's 35-point game, Kidd-Gilchrist shoulder, Kemba Walker's breakout, Courtney Lee trade, late surge
Bulls: Hoiberg's first season, Butler's 'coached harder' comments, Butler's 40-point half, Noah's shoulder, missed playoffs
Cavaliers: Kyrie Irving's return, David Blatt fired for Tyronn Lue, LeBron's shooting slump, top seed in the East
Mavericks: DeAndre Jordan fallout, Matthews and Parsons return, Dirk passes Shaq, late push to the playoffs
Nuggets: Ty Lawson traded, rookies Mudiay and Jokic, Gallinari's ankle, Will Barton's bench scoring
Pistons: Andre Drummond's double-doubles and All-Star nod, Hack-a-Drummond, Tobias Harris trade, first playoffs since 2009
Warriors: 24-0 start under Luke Walton, Kerr's return, chase of 72 wins, loss streaks at San Antonio and home ending
Rockets: Kevin McHale fired after 4-7 start, Bickerstaff interim, Dwight Howard trade talk, last playoff spot
Pacers: Paul George's return to form at power forward, Monta Ellis signing, Myles Turner, Vogel's future
Clippers: Blake Griffin's quad injury and punching incident, winning without him, Jeff Green trade
Lakers: Kobe Bryant's farewell tour, D'Angelo Russell's development and Nick Young video, franchise-worst record
Grizzlies: Randolph to the bench, Marc Gasol's broken foot, Jeff Green and Courtney Lee traded, record 28 players used
Heat: Hassan Whiteside's breakout, Chris Bosh's blood clots, Joe Johnson signing, Wade's resurgence
Bucks: Greg Monroe signing, Jason Kidd's hip surgery, Giannis at point guard, Jabari Parker's return, disappointing season
Timberwolves: Flip Saunders' death, Karl-Anthony Towns' rookie year, LaVine's dunk title, young core
Pelicans: injury-wrecked season, Anthony Davis' 59-point game and season-ending surgery, Gentry's first year
Knicks: Kristaps Porzingis' rookie season, Derek Fisher fired, Rambis interim, Melo's future
Thunder: Durant's healthy return, Westbrook's triple-doubles, Donovan's first season, late-game collapses
Magic: 19-13 start under Scott Skiles then January collapse, Aaron Gordon's dunk contest, Tobias Harris trade
76ers: record 0-18 start, Jerry Colangelo hired, Okafor's off-court trouble, Ish Smith trade, Hinkie's exit
Suns: Bledsoe's torn meniscus, Hornacek fired for Earl Watson, Markieff Morris saga, Devin Booker emerges
Blazers: life after Aldridge, McCollum's leap, Lillard's All-Star snub and 51-point game, playoff berth
Kings: Cousins and George Karl feud, Rondo's resurgence and slur suspension, last season at Sleep Train Arena
Spurs: Aldridge's arrival, Kawhi Leonard's MVP-level season, perfect home start, 67 wins, Duncan's 1,000th win
Raptors: Lowry and DeRozan lead a franchise-record season, Toronto hosts All-Star Weekend
Jazz: Exum's torn ACL, Gobert's knee sprain, Rodney Hood's emergence, missed playoffs on the final night
Wizards: Bradley Beal's leg injuries, Markieff Morris trade, missed playoffs, Wittman fired
2015 free agency: Aldridge, DeAndre Jordan, Monroe, Chandler, Ellis, Lin
2016 trade deadline deals: Tobias Harris, Markieff Morris, Jeff Green, Courtney Lee
All-Star Weekend in Toronto: Kobe's last All-Star Game, LaVine-Gordon dunk contest
Coaching changes: McHale, Blatt, Hollins, Fisher, Hornacek, Karl, Scott, Wittman, Vogel, Skiles, Joerger
Kobe Bryant's farewell tour across the league
2016 lottery: 76ers win No. 1; Lakers keep No. 2; Celtics get No. 3 via Brooklyn
2016 draft: Simmons, Ingram, Brown, Bender, Dunn, Hield, Murray; draft-night trades
